question_vi: SEO audit checklist cho frontend developer: cần kiểm tra những gì?
question_en: SEO audit checklist for frontend developers: what should you check?
answer_vi:
SEO audit checklist cho frontend developer bao gồm 5 nhóm: Technical, Content, Performance, Structured Data, và Crawlability.

Technical: (1) Tất cả pages return đúng status code (200, 301, 404), (2) sitemap.xml valid và submitted lên Google Search Console, (3) robots.txt không block important resources, (4) Canonical tags đúng trên mọi trang, (5) HTTPS enabled.

Content: (6) Mỗi trang có unique title (50-60 chars) và meta description (150-160 chars), (7) Nên có 1 `<h1>` rõ ràng chứa primary keyword (best practice, không phải requirement — Google xác nhận nhiều `<h1>` không phải vấn đề ranking), (8) Images có alt text, (9) Internal links với descriptive anchor text.

Performance: (10) Core Web Vitals pass (LCP <2.5s, INP <200ms, CLS <0.1), (11) Mobile-friendly, (12) No render-blocking resources.

Structured Data: (13) JSON-LD markup cho relevant schema types, (14) Validate qua Rich Results Test.

Crawlability: (15) No orphan pages, (16) No redirect chains/loops, (17) No duplicate content without canonical.

Tools: Google Search Console (free, essential), Lighthouse, Screaming Frog (crawl audit), Ahrefs/SEMrush (backlinks, keywords)
answer_en:
SEO audit checklist for frontend developers covers 5 categories: Technical, Content, Performance, Structured Data, and Crawlability.

Technical: (1) All pages return correct status codes (200, 301, 404), (2) sitemap.xml is valid and submitted to Google Search Console, (3) robots.txt is not blocking important resources, (4) Canonical tags are correct on every page, (5) HTTPS enabled.

Content: (6) Every page has unique title (50-60 chars) and meta description (150-160 chars), (7) One clear `<h1>` containing the primary keyword (a best practice, not a requirement — Google confirms multiple `<h1>` tags are not a ranking problem), (8) Images have alt text, (9) Internal links use descriptive anchor text.

Performance: (10) Core Web Vitals pass (LCP <2.5s, INP <200ms, CLS <0.1), (11) Mobile-friendly, (12) No render-blocking resources.

Structured Data: (13) JSON-LD markup for relevant schema types, (14) Validate via Rich Results Test.

Crawlability: (15) No orphan pages, (16) No redirect chains or loops, (17) No duplicate content without canonical.

Tools: Google Search Console (free, essential), Lighthouse, Screaming Frog (crawl audit), Ahrefs/SEMrush (backlinks, keywords)
